handback.title: Pull requests with no plan pass unless Dokima opened them
handback.summary: People and Dependabot can merge without a Dokima plan; Dokima's own pull requests still need one.
handback.user_story: People and Dependabot merge pull requests without a Dokima plan, while Dokima's own stay held to theirs.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a person opens a pull request with no approved plan, the Acceptance criteria check passes.
acceptance_criteria.words: The required "Acceptance criteria" check fails every PR without an approved Dokima plan, including human and Dependabot PRs.

edge_cases.case: The pull request names an issue that has no approved plan.

acceptance_criteria.text: When Dependabot opens a pull request with no approved plan, the Acceptance criteria check passes.
acceptance_criteria.words: The required "Acceptance criteria" check fails every PR without an approved Dokima plan, including human and Dependabot PRs.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Dependabot's pull requests name no issue, so there is one case.

acceptance_criteria.text: When Dokima opens an issue's pull request with no approved plan, the Acceptance criteria check still fails.
acceptance_criteria.words: only Dokima's own PRs are held to the plan
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Dokima opens an issue's pull request one way only, from its issue branch.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the unplanned pull requests setting is not allow, a person's unplanned pull request fails the check.

edge_cases.case: The pull request names an issue that has no approved plan.

test_changes.tests/test_manual_fix_check.py::test_onl: Owner's #744 lets a person's unplanned pull request pass; only Dokima still gets manual fix.
test_changes.tests/test_test_settings.py::test_prompt: Owner's #744 lets unplanned pull requests pass; still proves `.github/` gets no shortcut.
test_changes.tests/test_test_settings.py::test_the_fo: Owner's #744 lets unplanned pull requests pass; still proves listed folders get no shortcut.

answers.why: Agreed: the owner exempted people and Dependabot only, so an unknown author stays held.
